title: upstream crosslink: no combined machine-form status query
description: Upstream finding / absorption proposal for dollspace-gay/crosslink, 2026-07-20. Observation: assembling repo status (session + open issues + milestones) requires three subprocess invocations; the bootstrap statusline measured ~1.2s at 3 calls per repo. A single combined status query (machine form) would serve statuslines, agents, and CI in one acquisition. Evidence: the bootstrap statusline script of 2026-07-19 and the vsdd Status requirement's single-acquisition contract, which exists partly because the chassis has no combined query today.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Migrated to the canonical upstream (operator-directed workflow, decision on #597): re-verified STILL-LIVE at dollspace-gay/crosslink main 85691369 — session status --json emits zero lock fields; locks only via locks_cmd.rs:23-33; no combined command added since v0.8.0 — and filed as dollspace-gay/crosslink#17, which supersedes this record.
